runs.prompt: Add a preview method to Checkout in src/checkout.ts that takes the same session token, cart and discount as placeOrder and returns the quote that placeOrder would charge, without reserving stock or charging. Test it.
runs.finalMessage:
Added `Checkout.preview(token, cart, discount)` in [checkout.ts](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T12.2/run-02/repo/src/checkout.ts). It shares session validation, empty-cart handling, and pricing with `placeOrder`, then returns the quote without reserving stock or charging. The new behavior is linked as draft item `R-CHECKOUT-PREVIEW` in [trace/requirements.yaml](/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T12.2/run-02/repo/trace/requirements.yaml).
